This restaurant is a real pleasure...
Feb 2026 • Couples
I spend the winters in Vietnam and from North to South I make encounters of excellent local cuisine!
But every now and then, of Italian origin, I have to find pasta and pizza!
With "Sisters Tavern & Pizzeria" every year passing by Quy Nhon, modern town, with long sandy beach, I make meals in this restaurant.
The menu grew longer, the varieties of pasta and sauce even more numerous and frankly the ones I ate were such that in Italy, "al dente"!
And also "homemade" ravioli, like "the mamma"!
As for pizzas, I don't know of any other place in Vietnam where the dough is as crisp as a biscuit, with a Dalat mozarella, and all the sauces as in Italy. And the 4 cheeses with Camembert! This is great!
Would you like an ice cream?
Here too "homemade" good and creamy as in Italy!
Even espresso reminds me of the country! 
Go ahead and taste all these dishes, a restaurant "pleasure" in a new, clean and a really nice boss like his collaborators.
Have a great time 🤗

I’d skip this place.
Mar 2025 • Solo
This restaurant did not live up to the positive review's. I ordered a Caesar salad and a chicken dish with white wine and mushroom sauce. Wine isn’t sold by the glass, for a ‘tavern’ this was disappointing. The salad was swimming with dressing so everything was soggy, and had hard boiled egg which is not traditional. Large portion but could have been tastier. The chicken dish was tasteless and the few potato wedges that came in the side were not enough. The place has the feel of a cafe and definitely not a tavern and has ‘0’ atmosphere. I guess the owner had an idea for a restaurant on the Spanish /Italian side but knows nothing about the cuisine or ambience. Overpriced for the quality of the food. This was my only meal for the day and I was ill the following day, can’t say for certain it was this place but either way, I wouldn’t return.
